name: Senior Transport & Disability Support
tagline: NDIS transport, medical appointments, social outings
extra_prompt: You are booking for a senior transport and disability support service. Ask about the passenger's mobility needs, whether a wheelchair or hoist is needed, the appointment time, and the pickup and drop-off addresses. Ask whether an escort or carer is needed. Ask about NDIS funding if applicable. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed at booking. Do not provide medical advice.

kb.a: {price_note} Fares depend on distance, wait time and mobility needs. We confirm the price before you book.
Yes, we accept NDIS funding. Ask us to confirm how your plan is managed so we can agree the payment arrangement before you book.

kb.q: Do you have wheelchair accessible vehicles?
kb.a: Yes, we run wheelchair accessible vehicles. Tell us your wheelchair type and size when you book so we can send the right vehicle.

kb.q: Do you help with hospital discharge?
kb.a: Yes, we collect patients from hospital and help them into their home. Tell us the ward, discharge time and address when you book.
Yes, we can wait during appointments. Waiting time is charged in 30-minute blocks at the rate on your quote.

kb.q: Can a carer travel with the passenger?
kb.a: Yes, one carer or companion can travel with the passenger. Let us know when you book so we can plan the vehicle space.
Yes, we take regular weekly and fortnightly bookings. Tell us the days and times, and we will confirm the schedule with you.
Yes, we do dialysis transport, including early morning runs. Tell us your treatment days and times so we can plan the route.
Yes, we take passengers to shopping, cafes, events and other outings. Tell us where you want to go and what help you need on the trip.
Yes, we do airport transfers and can help with luggage and check-in. Tell us your flight time and terminal when you book.
Yes, our drivers complete [screening checks, e.g. police check and working with children check] and [first aid training]. Ask us to confirm the current checks for your driver.
Yes, we offer support work, including companionship and community access. Support work is charged per hour at the rate on your quote.
Yes, we run small group outings. Tell us the group size and destination so we can match the vehicle.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Please call us as soon as your plans change.
Yes, we hold [insurance type] insurance through [insurer]. Certificates are available on request.
We service [your service area, e.g. the local metro area]. Ask us to confirm your suburb before booking.

Remind coordinator 30 days before a check expires

compliance.guidance: Working With Children Checks apply to childcare and any work with children. Aged and disability support has worker screening and registration rules (for example through the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission or the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission). Keep client health details restricted to staff who need them.
